definition_en: a place of punishment after death, or a word used for swearing and emphasis

senses.title: Place of punishment

definition_en: to put something where it cannot be seen, or to keep something secret
core_image: 把东西塞进看不见的角落，自己也缩进去
scene: 猫藏在沙发后面。The cat hid behind the sofa.
sceneCN: 这里 hide 是「躲藏」（第 1 个义项）；句意：猫藏在沙发后面。

senses.title: Conceal oneself
senses.definition: to go somewhere where you cannot be seen
senses.definitionCN: 到别人看不见的地方
senses.example: The cat hid behind the sofa.
senses.exampleCN: 猫藏在沙发后面。
senses.why: This is the basic physical sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最基本的身体动作义项。

senses.title: Keep secret
senses.definition: to keep something secret from others
senses.definitionCN: 对别人保守某事的秘密
senses.example: She hid the truth from her family.
senses.exampleCN: 她对家人隐瞒了真相。
senses.why: A secret is hidden like an object.
senses.whyCN: 秘密就像物件一样被藏起来。

senses.title: Block from view
senses.definition: to cover something so it cannot be seen
senses.definitionCN: 遮住某物使其看不见
senses.example: Clouds hid the moon.
senses.exampleCN: 云遮住了月亮。
senses.why: Things can hide other things without moving.
senses.whyCN: 事物不动也能遮住别的东西。

intro.en: Hide is an old Germanic verb for covering something.
intro.cn: hide 是古老的日耳曼语动词，意为遮盖。

items.en: The root meant to cover or conceal.
items.cn: 该词根意为遮盖或隐藏。

items.en: Hyan meant to hide.
items.cn: hydan 意为隐藏。

items.en: Hide also meant to keep a secret.
items.cn: hide 也意为保守秘密。

items.en: The past form hid and hidden settled.
items.cn: 过去式 hid 和过去分词 hidden 固定下来。

items.en: Hide and seek named the children's game.
items.cn: hide and seek 成为儿童游戏捉迷藏。

note.en: Hide is compared with look-alike words and with words for concealing.
note.cn: 把 hide 与形近词以及表示隐藏的词作比较。

abstract.en: A hidden door still knows the shape of the room.

definition_en: far above the ground, large in amount or level, or important in rank
core_image: 从地面向上量出的一大段距离
scene: 这堵墙有两米高。The wall is two metres high.
sceneCN: 这里 high 是「高的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：这堵墙有两米高。

senses.title: Tall
senses.definition: measuring a great distance from bottom to top
senses.definitionCN: 从底到顶的距离很大的
senses.example: The wall is two metres high.
senses.exampleCN: 这堵墙有两米高。
senses.why: This is the basic physical sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最基本的物理义项。

senses.title: Large in amount
senses.definition: large in amount, level, or degree
senses.definitionCN: 数量、水平或程度很大的
senses.example: The price was too high for us.
senses.exampleCN: 这个价格对我们来说太高了。
senses.why: A large amount is pictured as high.
senses.whyCN: 大的数量被想象成高的。

senses.title: Top rank
senses.definition: important or of good quality
senses.definitionCN: 重要的或质量好的
senses.example: She holds a high position in the company.
senses.exampleCN: 她在公司里担任高级职位。
senses.why: Rank is pictured as height.
senses.whyCN: 地位被想象成高度。

senses.title: At a height
senses.definition: at or to a great height
senses.definitionCN: 在高处或向高处
senses.example: The kite flew high above the trees.
senses.exampleCN: 风筝在树林上空高高飞着。
senses.why: The adjective also works as an adverb.
senses.whyCN: 形容词也可作副词使用。
